tasks.name: Physics Specification
tasks.objective: Produce the Physics Specification for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Fixed timestep, substeps and interpolation policy stated
Collision layers and their interactions tabulated
Determinism requirements stated for multiplayer or replay use

tasks.name: Collision and Body Setup
tasks.objective: Produce the Collision and Body Setup for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Every collidable object has an appropriate collider and layer
Character controller handles slopes, steps and edges without sticking
Projectiles and destructibles behave to the GDD numbers

tasks.name: Physics Validation
tasks.objective: Produce the Physics Validation for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: No tunnelling through walls at maximum speed
Object counts at peak measured against the physics budget
Known edge cases documented with reproduction steps
